description: This file defines the interface for a Key-Value Pair (KVP) framework used in unit testing. It includes status codes, data structures, and function prototypes for creating, destroying, opening, parsing, and querying key-value data stored in various formats (file, memory). It provides functions to retrieve values of different data types (bool, integers, strings, float, double), serialize data, and access data bytes associated with keys.

methods.name: ut_kvp_createInstance
methods.description: Creates a new KVP instance and returns a handle to it.

methods.name: ut_kvp_destroyInstance
methods.description: Destroys a given KVP instance, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: ut_kvp_open
methods.description: Opens and parses a KVP file into the specified instance.

methods.name: ut_kvp_openMemory
methods.description: Parses a serialized KVP payload from caller-owned memory into the instance.

methods.name: ut_kvp_close
methods.description: Closes the KVP instance and frees associated resources.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getBoolField
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value for a specified key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt8Field
methods.description: Retrieves a uint8_t value for a specified key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt16Field
methods.description: Retrieves a uint16_t value for a specified key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt32Field
methods.description: Retrieves a uint32_t value for a specified key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt64Field
methods.description: Retrieves a uint64_t value for a specified key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getStringField
methods.description: Retrieves a string value for a specified key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getFloatField
methods.description: Retrieves a float value for a specified key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getDoubleField
methods.description: Retrieves a double value for a specified key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_fieldPresent
methods.description: Checks if a specified key is present in the KVP data.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getData
methods.description: Returns a serialized textual representation of the KVP instance.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getListCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of list entries for a key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getDataBytes
methods.description: Retrieves data bytes associated with a specific key.

ctags.name: UT_KVP_STATUS_FILE_OPEN_ERROR
ctags.pattern: /^    UT_KVP_STATUS_FILE_OPEN_ERROR,   \/**!< Failed to open the file. *\/$/

ctags.name: UT_KVP_STATUS_KEY_NOT_FOUND
ctags.pattern: /^    UT_KVP_STATUS_KEY_NOT_FOUND,     \/**!< Key not found in the KVP instance. *\/$/

ctags.name: UT_KVP_STATUS_MAX
ctags.pattern: /^    UT_KVP_STATUS_MAX                \/**!< Out of range marker (not a valid status). *\/$/
